channel.description: Latest articles from Paste Media Group (pastemagazine.com)

item.title: Lesley Manville and Ciarán Hinds deftly confront marriage malaise in Midwinter Break
item.description: Lesley Manville and Ciarán Hinds conjure up their best inner struggles for Polly Findlay's feature debut, Midwinter Break.

item.title: On luck... or something, Hilary Duff’s grown-up reflections coast by on childhood nostalgia
item.description: The Disney star’s first album in over a decade resurrects the buoyant pop of 2003’s Metamorphosis, pushing it forward for a new generation. Still, the album’s “mature comeback” offerings never fully deliver.

item.title: Woody and Buzz try, fail to compete with screentime in the Toy Story 5 trailer
item.description: Coming this June, Pixar's latest, Toy Story 5, explores a world where toys are obsolete as Bonnie gets a new tech-toy: The Lilypad.

item.title: Great job, Internet!: Hollywood uncooked as viral Cruise vs. Pitt video looks like another AI con-job
item.description: Rest easy, Marvel screenwriters. The video that supposedly cooked Hollywood was, get this, appears to be made by humans to hype AI.

item.title: 5 songs you need to hear this week (February 19, 2026)
item.description: Irreversible Entanglements’ free-jazz prayer, My New Band Believe's maximalist multiverse, and Ozzie Hair’s sludgy, psychic death garage-rock.

item.title: Robert Duvall's strength was finding the blood in stony men
item.description: A rock-solid physical presence, the Oscar-winning actor Robert Duvall always let emotion dance behind his eyes.

item.title: Bill Hader sets divorced-dad nightmare, They Know, as feature directorial debut
item.description: Barry star Bill Hader will share the horrors of being a divorced dad in They Know, which begins production in LA this spring.

item.title: Bob Odenkirk reloads for more action-comedy in the trailer for Normal
item.description: A flurry of bullets is expected in Normal, the new snowy action-comedy starring Bob Odenkirk, Lena Headey, and Henry Winkler.

item.title: AMC rejects plan to sneak AI-generated short into its advertising pre-roll
item.description: The theater chain made it very clear that an AI-made short called "Thanksgiving Day" would not be running in front of any of its movies.
